input.quote: 22.3 A Party may at any time assign, sell or transfer the whole of' its rights and obligations under this Agreement to:
input.rationale: Paragraph 22 gives us the assignment rights we want (22.3 lets a Party assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate without consent, with only timely written notice under 22.6), so the preferred Customer-side elements are already met. It fails the fallback and preferred on the counterparty side: the same no-consent carve-outs in 22.3, 22.4 and 22.5 apply to every other Party, so other Parties may assign to their successors and affiliates without our consent, and consent under 22.2 runs to the Management Committee rather than to us. There is also no bar on assignment to our competitors. We therefore target preferred (rather than cutting back our own affiliate rights to reach the fallback) and add a single new Subparagraph 22.7 that conforms 22.2-22.5 to require our prior written consent, not unreasonably withheld, bars assignment to our competitors, and confirms that a change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. gives no other Party a termination right (no such right exists today).

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
mappings.quote: (e) a Subsidiary or Affiliate of that Party; and (d) another Subsidiary or Affiliate of that Party's Parent Company.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.

proposal.summary: Add new Subparagraph 22.7 requiring Teleglobe's consent (not unreasonably withheld) to other Parties' assignments, barring assignment to our competitors, and confirming no change-of-control termination right.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 22 currently lets every other Party assign to its successors, parents and affiliates without our consent, so we added Subparagraph 22.7 requiring our prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld) for assignments by other Parties, prohibiting assignment to our competitors, and confirming that a change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. gives no other Party a termination right. Our own affiliate and successor rights under 22.3 are preserved.

ops.text: Subparagraphs 22.2, 22.3, 22.4 and 22.5 do not permit any Party other than Teleglobe USA Inc. to assign, sell or transfer the whole or any part of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Teleglobe USA Inc., which must not be unreasonably withheld, and no such assignment, sale or transfer may be made to a competitor of Teleglobe USA Inc. A change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. does not give any other Party any right to terminate this Agreement or Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in it.
